sources.title: Michael F. Atiyah and Raoul Bott, The Moment Map and Equivariant Cohomology
sources.locator: §2 pushforward and Thom-class construction, printed pp. 4–6; §3 Lemma 3.3, Proposition 3.4, Theorem 3.5 and equation (3.7), printed pp. 6–9.

source_review.read_extent: The full pushforward and Thom-class passages in printed pp. 4–6 were inspected, including the normal-bundle support construction.
source_review.supports: The relative Thom-to-absolute Gysin route used after excision in the local proof.
source_review.limitations: The local proof states the selected Milnor Borel base hypotheses and verifies the compact tubular-pair excision directly.

contents.name: §3 Lemma 3.3 and Proposition 3.4: orbit-isotropy support and localized injectivity

source_review.read_extent: The complete lemma and proposition proofs in printed pp. 6–8 were inspected, including the orbit-tube cover and exact-sequence argument.
source_review.supports: The finite orbit-slice cover and Mayer–Vietoris localization mechanism for the nonfixed locus.
source_review.limitations: The authored proof adds the punctured fixed-tube radial retraction and proves the full-subgroup character annihilator locally.

contents.name: §3 Theorem 3.5: restriction to the fixed locus after localization

source_review.read_extent: The complete theorem and proof in printed pp. 8–9 were inspected, including its compactness, fixed-locus and localization hypotheses.
source_review.supports: The compact finite-dimensional Borel restriction isomorphism after localization.
source_review.limitations: No noncompact or compact-support extension is taken from this theorem.

contents.name: §3 equation (3.7): product of normal character weights in the Euler class

source_review.read_extent: The complete displayed equation and immediately preceding normal-weight derivation in printed pp. 8–9 were inspected.
source_review.supports: Restriction of the equivariant normal Euler class to a point is the product of the nontrivial character classes.
source_review.limitations: The local proof supplies the nilpotent positive fixed-component correction and its explicit finite inverse.

sources.title: Shubham Dwivedi, Jonathan Herman, Lisa C. Jeffrey, and Theo van den Hurk, Hamiltonian Group Actions and Equivariant Cohomology

contents.name: §9.9 Example 9.48: fixed components and normal weights

source_review.read_extent: The full example and its normal-representation discussion on PDF pp. 85–86 were inspected.
source_review.supports: Fixed-locus submanifold structure and nontrivial normal weights for compact torus actions.
source_review.limitations: The local proof derives the metric, fixed-set charts, and smooth character subbundles without assuming symplectic or Hamiltonian structure.

source_review.read_extent: The full theorem and proof on PDF pp. 86–87 were inspected, including the finite cover, Thom map and Euler denominator.
source_review.supports: The compact torus fixed-point restriction theorem in Borel equivariant cohomology.
source_review.limitations: The book's short injectivity step is not used as a substitute for the authored pair exactness and complement proof.

contents.name: §9.10 orbit neighborhoods and finite-cover Mayer–Vietoris argument

source_review.read_extent: The complete orbit-neighborhood and Mayer–Vietoris passages in the Theorem 9.50 proof were inspected.
source_review.supports: Localized vanishing on subsets covered by finitely many proper-isotropy slices.
source_review.limitations: The local item supplies the exact isotropy character, Borel line trivialization, and the tube around the fixed locus.

sources.locator: §3.2, Theorem 3.19 and the displayed projective-space calculation, printed pp. 220–222.

contents.name: Theorem 3.19: integral cohomology ring of complex projective space

source_review.read_extent: The complete theorem and proof passage on printed pp. 220–222 was inspected, including the generator and power calculation.
source_review.supports: The integral projective-space ring used to identify the rational coefficient generator of BT.
source_review.limitations: The coefficient change, finite products and character-lattice formula are proved locally.

source_review.read_extent: The full proposition and proof on printed p. 35 were inspected.
source_review.supports: The compact-Hausdorff paracompact boundary case in the product-base lemma.
source_review.limitations: The actual BT times F product refinement is proved locally rather than inferred from productivity of paracompactness.

source_review.limitations: The cover and local bundle numeration used later still obey the support-subordinate convention.
